items.hook: Mongolian wrestling, known as Bökh, is the folk wrestling style of Mongols in Mongolia, Inner Mongolia, Buryat Mongol regions, Kalmyk Mongol and other regions where touching the ground with anything other than foot or palm of hand loses the match.
items.body: Bökh means "firmness, reliability, vitality, wrestler", from Mongolic root *bekü "firm, hard, solid; fighter, strong man" Wrestling is the most important of the Mongolian culture's historic "Three Manly Skills", that also include horsemanship and archery. The

items.hook: The Sonoma County Historical Society (SCHS) is the county-wide historical society in Sonoma County, California.
items.body: It is dedicated to the preservation and public access to historical sites, materials and documents. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.

items.hook: The Downing Street Years is a memoir by Margaret Thatcher, former Prime Minister of the United Kingdom, covering her premiership of 1979 to 1990.
items.body: It was accompanied by a four-part BBC television series of the same name. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.

items.hook: The Karnabo is a creature of Ardennes folklore.
items.body: It is reputedly the offspring of a supernatural entity and a Bohemian traveller. The world is stranger than it lets on.

items.hook: Taimur Saleem Khan Jhagra is a Pakistani politician who was the Provincial Minister of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa for Finance and Health, in office from 29 August 2018 to 18 January 2023.
items.body: He was a member of the Provincial Assembly of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa from August 2018 to January 2023. One of those things you can't un-know.
